sentences.en: Andi plays the drums in the school band at the arts show.
sentences.ko: 안디는 예술제에서 학교 밴드의 드럼을 쳐요.

sentences.text: Suara drum dari pawai di luar terdengar sampai ke bangsal.
sentences.en: The sound of drums from the parade outside could be heard all the way to the ward.
sentences.ko: 밖에서 열린 행진의 북소리가 병동까지 들렸어요.

sentences.text: Seorang aktris terkenal datang ke sekolah Andi untuk memberi motivasi.
sentences.en: A famous actress came to Andi's school to give a motivational talk.
sentences.ko: 유명 여배우가 안디의 학교에 와서 동기 부여 강연을 했어요.

sentences.text: Seorang aktris senior dirawat di lantai khusus setelah jatuh di lokasi syuting.
sentences.en: A veteran actress was treated on the VIP floor after falling on a film set.
sentences.ko: 한 원로 여배우가 촬영장에서 넘어진 뒤 특실 병동에서 치료를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Andi memakai aplikasi kamus untuk mengerjakan tugas bahasa Jerman.
sentences.en: Andi uses a dictionary app to do his German homework.
sentences.ko: 안디는 독일어 숙제를 할 때 사전 앱을 써요.

sentences.text: Rumah sakit meluncurkan aplikasi untuk mendaftar antrean dokter.
sentences.en: The hospital launched an app for booking a place in the doctor's queue.
sentences.ko: 병원은 진료 대기 접수를 하는 앱을 내놓았어요.
